purpose: Final targeted production-hygiene validation: proves (1) the strengthened business title/heading rule fixes the last two Batch-1 business blockers, and (2) the new arts_text_suppression_policy controls the 14/89 (15.7%) arts.* text-leak cluster from Batch 1. Reuses exact Batch-1 offender IDs (business.product_management, business.fire_movement) and exact Batch-1/prior-remediation arts offender IDs from production_batch_001_v1/qa_layer2_human_review_v1.json and remediation_test_12_v1/qa_results_v1.json.
fixes_under_test: business_text_suppression_policy title/heading paragraph added this round (no title/heading/caption above any diagram, board, roadmap, or kanban board, even short named-diagram titles like 'Roadmap' or 'Life Map')
new arts_text_suppression_policy (new global_style_v1.json field, auto-applied to every canonical_interest_id starting with 'arts.')

business.product_management.original_defect: Prior remediation round (remediation_test_12_v1): despite the business no-readable-text policy, still rendered a large readable 'Product Roadmap' title plus column headers 'Discover/Validate/Build/Launch/Optimize' on the dominant foreground whiteboard.

business.fire_movement.original_defect: Prior remediation round: book-spine 'FINANCE' and whiteboard 'Mind Map' header were fixed, but a new large readable 'Life Map' title appeared on the primary planning sheet.

arts.zine_making.original_defect: Batch-1 and prior remediation round (both): the literal hobby name 'ZINE' renders repeatedly, clearly readable, on multiple zine/prop covers; 'COMICS' also readable on a shelf book.

arts.comedy_writing.original_defect: Batch-1 and prior remediation round (both): whiteboard flowchart extensively readable; book cover clearly reads 'THESAURUS'; prior remediation additionally showed a full readable joke line in the notebook.

arts.hip_hop_dance.original_defect: Batch-1: large, fully legible graffiti wall text - 'FLOW', 'CYPHER', 'UNITY EST. 98'. The most severe signage-family text leak in the whole 120-card batch.

arts.voice_acting.original_defect: Batch-1: script pages held by multiple actors show small but clearly legible Japanese text.

arts.calligraphy.cause_family: workshop wall scrolls (art-form-inherent text stress test)
arts.calligraphy.original_defect: Batch-1: multiple background wall-scroll characters beyond the one semantically-necessary in-progress brushstroke. Deliberately chosen because calligraphy is the hardest possible stress test for a text-suppression policy - the craft itself is about writing characters.

arts.webcomics.original_defect: Batch-1: tablet shows visible toolbar icon chrome (screen-policy leak); comic book cover shows a hero-like figure with book-cover text.

avoided: no unrelated successful Batch-1 or prior-remediation image is being regenerated - all 8 ids here have a documented prior text-leak defect

final_production_hygiene_gate.note: One tiny ambiguous non-linguistic scribble is not a failure. Clearly readable invented words/titles/headings ARE failures.

decision_rule.green: Known Batch-1 production-hygiene clusters (business titles, arts readable text) are controlled; Batch 2 MAY be considered after a new explicit user authorization.
decision_rule.amber: A localized blocker remains; Batch 2 stays locked.
decision_rule.red: The policy approach failed; production stays stopped.
